assumptions: The model is an intrinsically spatial-lattice Kogut-Susskind Hamiltonian theory; no unique local continuum Lagrangian is inferred.
The otherwise unspecified Hamiltonian normalization is resolved as H = -(1/a)*(g^2 sum X + g^(-2) sum B).
No gauge fixing or vacuum-energy subtraction is applied.
The phrase Gauss's law: 0 denotes zero gauge charge and hence G_v=+1, not an eigenvalue G_v=0.
Boundary conditions are not selected here and remain a downstream realization choice.
The 4 by 4 lattice size is a finite-lattice realization parameter rather than a continuum coupling.

definitions.canonical_expression: H = -(1/a)*(g^2*sum_{ell} X_ell + g^(-2)*sum_{p} B_p), with B_p = product_{ell in boundary(p)} Z_ell
G_v = product_{ell incident on v} X_ell

model.gauge_structure: local Z2 gauge symmetry generated at each spatial-lattice vertex v by G_v = product_{ell incident on v} X_ell
model.name: 2+1 dimensional pure Z2 gauge theory in Kogut-Susskind formalism

observable_contract.gauge_invariance: Gauge invariant because [G_v,H]=0 for every vertex v
observable_contract.hermiticity_consequence: For the specified diagonal matrix elements, the imaginary component is exactly zero
observable_contract.name: user_observable

resolved_conventions.link_algebra: X_ell^2=Z_ell^2=1 and X_ell Z_ell=-Z_ell X_ell; operators on distinct links commute
resolved_conventions.time_realization: continuous Hamiltonian time; if downstream time discretization is introduced, the supplied convention requires a_t=a

symmetries.name: local Z2 gauge symmetry
symmetries.operator: G_v = product_{ell incident on v} X_ell

symmetries.boundary_dependence: Noncontractible generators exist when supported by the downstream boundary geometry; on a periodic square lattice there are two independent generators
symmetries.name: electric Z2 one-form symmetry
symmetries.operator: T(gamma_star) = product_{ell intersecting gamma_star} X_ell for a closed dual-lattice curve gamma_star

symmetries.name: time reversal
symmetries.operator: Theta = K in the real Pauli basis

symmetries.conservation_law: U_s H U_s^(-1) = H whenever the chosen boundary realization preserves the automorphism
symmetries.name: square-lattice automorphisms
symmetries.operator: unitary link permutations induced by translations, quarter-turn rotations, and reflections
